name: Centralized controller in Power BI integration with PowerPoint
description: The Centralized controller in Power BI aims to enhance productivity for Power BI users who embed Power BI content in their PowerPoint presentations. This feature introduces a designated pane that provides a centralized location within the presentation, allowing users to execute an operation on all of the Power BI add-ins in the presentation with a sinlge click. This eliminates the need to manually update each slide, thereby streamlining the process of refreshing data and managing content across multiple slides. The Controller will offer various operations such as changing view modes, and refreshing data.
